scenarios.name: Move the model browser between side docks

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the model browser is docked to the left edge of the workspace
the user drags its header to the right edge of the workspace
the model browser docks at the right edge
the viewport occupies the workspace to its left
the user drags its header to the left edge of the workspace
the model browser docks at the left edge
